O projekcie
In the cluster Daily Banking Middletier, we shape the digital banking experience for millions of retail and corporate customers. With around 20 specialized cells across four locations, we are responsible for the core backend and middletier services behind online and mobile banking, delivering them securely, with high availability, and in full regulatory compliance.
What sets us apart is that we combine reliable platform ownership with genuine future-focused work. We are modernizing a complex system landscape with AI, establishing cross-channel standards, and thereby enabling new digital and AI-supported use cases across the bank. People who join us help shape critical infrastructure with visible impact on customers, operations, and the bank’s strategic evolution.
In order to ensure compliance with current market trends, regulatory requirements as well as Commerzbank’s Book-of-Stardards (BOS) requirements we look for a committed and passionate development engineer to technologically move forward our paper-based payments business.

Zakres obowiązków
- Implementation of production requirements and their documentation
- Analysis and implementation of technical production requirements for the software used, including BOS requirements
- Open and execute changes with smaller project and infrastructure operations
- Support in fault analysis, also in TU-C environment
- Perform technical acceptance tests (ACT): Installation and first functional tests
- Support the Product Owner in the technical analysis of requirements with regard to the software used
- Support of the operating colleagues in the maintenance of jobs in the task scheduler (e.g. UC4)
- Input on COMDIA description of technical users and technical rights, recertification
- Maintenance of mandatory documents: Compliance Check / PO cockpit
- Opening of changes for production operations (major technical infrastructure topics as well as major specialist topics/application uses); Change Coordination
- Support of business experts in specialist regression tests, specialist tests in the core systems for the documented payment transactions
- Transfer of software to ADIS (Application Deployment information Service) - handover and storage of software to be installed in accordance with the audit and mapping of deployment processes

Wymagania
- Java, Javascript
- Spring (both MVC and Boot)
- Web Technologies: REST, JSP, XML, AJAX
- Spring (both MVC and Boot)
- Dev-Tools: Eclipse, GIT, JIRA
- CICD
- (Bitbucket, TeamCity)
- Database: PostgreSQL
- OS: Windows, Linux
- Fluency in English at a minimum B2 level.

title: Full Stack Developer (Java + Angular)
description:
O projekcie
Poszukujemy doświadczonego Full Stack Developera (Java + Angular), który dołączy do zespołu odpowiedzialnego za rozwój i utrzymanie nowoczesnych aplikacji wspierających usługi kartowe i płatnicze.
Projekt obejmuje rozwój aplikacji biznesowych dostępnych przez Internet, wdrażanie nowych funkcjonalności, optymalizację istniejących rozwiązań oraz zapewnienie wysokiego poziomu bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i niezawodności systemów.
Szukamy osoby, która swobodnie porusza się zarówno w technologiach backendowych, jak i frontendowych, posiada doświadczenie w architekturze mikroserwisowej oraz potrafi samodzielnie rozwiązywać problemy techniczne.
Technologie
Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST API, Apache Kafka
Frontend: Angular, Angular Material
Bazy danych: SQL
DevOps / CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, CI/CD
Security: SAST, OWASP, Secure Coding, Container Scanning, Dependency Scanning, DevSecOps
AI Tools: GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI Agents
Metodyka: Agile, Scrum

Zakres obowiązków
- Projektowanie, rozwój, testowanie i utrzymanie aplikacji z wykorzystaniem Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Kafka, SQL, Docker i Kubernetes.
- Tworzenie i rozwijanie rozwiązań opartych na architekturze mikroserwisowej.
- Projektowanie, implementacja i utrzymanie REST API oraz integracji z systemami wewnętrznymi i zewnętrznymi.
- Rozwój interfejsów użytkownika z wykorzystaniem Angular i Angular Material.
- Analiza i rozwiązywanie błędów aplikacyjnych, incydentów oraz problemów produkcyjnych.
- Identyfikacja i usuwanie podatności bezpieczeństwa wykrywanych przez SAST, skanowanie kontenerów, skanowanie zależności oraz testy penetracyjne.
- Stosowanie zasad Secure Coding, OWASP oraz Clean Code.
- Wspieranie procesów CI/CD z wykorzystaniem Git, Bitbucket i Jenkins.
- Optymalizacja wydajności, skalowalności, stabilności i bezpieczeństwa aplikacji.
- Współpraca z analitykami, architektami, Product Ownerami oraz zespołami bezpieczeństwa i utrzymania.
- Udział w pracach zespołu realizowanych zgodnie z metodyką Agile/Scrum.
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej.
- Wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI, takich jak GitHub Copilot i Microsoft 365 Copilot, w celu usprawnienia developmentu, testowania i dokumentowania rozwiązań.
- Udział w inicjatywach związanych z automatyzacją oraz wykorzystaniem AI Agents w procesach wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Wymagania
- Minimum 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w roli Full Stack Java Developera.

- Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji frontendowych z wykorzystaniem Angular i Angular Material.
- Doświadczenie w pracy z Apache Kafka oraz bazami danych SQL.
- Znajomość Docker i Kubernetes.
- Praktyczna znajomość Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins oraz procesów CI/CD.

- Doświadczenie w analizie i usuwaniu podatności bezpieczeństwa wykrywanych przez SAST, Container Scanning i Dependency Scanning.
- Znajomość zasad Secure Coding i OWASP.

- Doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku Agile/Scrum.

title: Software Engineer (Java)

title: Network Automation Leader for Microwave technology
description:
O projekcie
About the Role:
Join Orange's innovation team to lead the automation of microwave network infrastructure. You will focus on standardizing network models, implementing automated testing, and developing automation components within a strategic program. You will be member of the Microwave Technology team primarily based in Poland under the supervision of a local team lead supporting and bridging communication with Paris-based management.
You will be collaborating with an international team in charge of Automatizing Transmission Network for Orange affiliates with technoilogies such as Microwave, Optical, WDM and IP Technologies
About the Team:
Microwave technology enables wireless point-to-point transmission between two sites, offering optimized costs and time-to-market. In Orange's mobile networks, 4 out of 5 sites are served with at least microwave links.
The Microwave Department consists of 6 team members.
In addition, there are activities related to anticipation and R&D, with active participation in international standardization organizations and spectrum regulation (obtaining licenses from national regulators), as well as research projects on AI.
For Orange subsidiaries, we handle link design, define architectural evolution, and establish engineering rules to optimize investments. We also integrate activities from the Skill Center, including validation, sourcing, and deployment follow-up.
Our industrial suppliers include Aviat, Ericsson, Huawei, Nokia, and ZTE.
We closely monitor carbon impacts and seek to optimize energy consumption through more efficient hardware and activation of software functionalities.
Finally, the automation leader drives microwave network automation through the Andiamo program (Automation & Data Integration with AI enablers for Microwave, IP, and Optical networks).

Zakres obowiązków
- Standardization: Collaborate with international operators and vendors to define, promote, and validate NETCONF/YANG models, organizing ETSI sessions and ensuring standards compliance.
- Automation Testing: Design, test, and maintain automation scripts (Robot Framework) for validating network models with major vendors like Ericsson, Huawei, Nokia, and ZTE.
- Development: Lead automation activities within the Andiamo program, translating needs into technical components, supporting deployment, and ensuring standards compliance.
- Communication & Collaboration: Work effectively with international teams, vendors, and stakeholders, maintaining clear communication in English.

Wymagania
- Strong programming skills in Java (Spring Boot) and Python.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitLab, GitOps, Kubernetes, and containerized environments.
- Knowledge of network management systems and protocols (SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, RESTCONF, APIs).
- Excellent English communication skills; ability to work in a multicultural, dynamic environment.
- Autonomous, proactive, solution-oriented, with good teamwork and adaptability.

title: Software Engineer III, Context Intelligence, Knowledge Catalog
description:
O projekcie
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
The Context Intelligence team builds the data discovery and context serving foundations for Google Cloud. When enterprise organizations use artificial intelligence assistants to analyze their data, those assistants need clear context about what tables exist, how datasets relate to each other, and how data is used across the business. Our team solves this by transforming raw metadata into structured, searchable knowledge.
Working from our engineering hub in Warsaw, you will join a collaborative group of engineers who design distributed storage systems, graph search services, and data analysis pipelines. You will partner directly with teams building cloud databases, data governance tools, and conversational assistants to shape how enterprises interact with their data.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

- Design, build, and maintain distributed backend services that organize and deliver enterprise data context to AI agents across Google Cloud.

- Build data processing pipelines that analyze query history and usage patterns to automatically enrich metadata and filter out unused schema information.
- Create automated evaluation frameworks and testing tools to measure retrieval accuracy, response speed, and system efficiency.
- Collaborate with product managers and partner engineering teams across data analytics and artificial intelligence platforms to integrate new capabilities and support production operations.

You will be leading a dedicated team of 6 software engineers, driving the core money-out movement and compliance systems of Poland's dominant e-commerce payment platform.
Here's why you should join us:
High-Impact Domain: Work at the ultimate execution layer of Allegro Finance. Your team owns the critical systems that move billions of PLN from internal ledgers out into the physical banking system. Every delay or error here has direct financial and reputational impacts on our sellers and our license as a Krajowa Instytucja Płatnicza (KIP).
Fintech & Compliance Innovation: Drive critical initiatives at the intersection of complex banking rails and regulatory requirements. Your team will build, optimize, and secure automated payout orchestration, real-time sanctions screening, multi-currency foreign exchange pipelines, and legally mandated court-ordered bailiff seizure mechanisms.
Deep Technical Integrity: Develop mission-critical operations with strict recovery, zero-data-loss, and high-availability guarantees.
Important things for you:
Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.

Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
Our team is based in Poznań.

Zakres obowiązków
- Managing, mentoring, and supporting an engineering team of 6 backend developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, absolute financial precision, and ownership.
- Overseeing the development of the core payouts engine including banking connectivity (mBank/PKO BP/PayU via SOAP/REST), automated bundling strategies, and ISO 20022/CAMT statement parsers.
- Collaborating closely with Compliance, Legal, and Finance stakeholders to ensure payouts and legal holds (seizures, blockades) are executed with 100% regulatory compliance and audit readiness.
- Guiding architectural decisions across the stack — from our high-throughput Kotlin and Spring Boot APIs, reactive messaging pipelines (Azure Service Bus), to MongoDB/PostgreSQL optimizations.

- Solid understanding of fixed income, FX, interest rate derivatives, and credit derivatives.
